name: Hobgoblin Warrior
notes: Martial Advantage: extra 2d6 damage once per turn when ally within 5ft of TARGET. AC 18 = hard to hit, dies fast when you do. Formation fighters — always manoeuvre for Martial Advantage. Ladder assault specialists.
gm_notes: Hobgoblins are disciplined military units. They WAIT to attack until formation is set. First hobgoblin on the wall holds position and protects the ladder for the second. Second up = Martial Advantage for BOTH. Tactically scary because they optimize rather than rush. Mix with orcs: orcs bust open the line, hobgoblins exploit it.
